We need produce heat_advisory JSON. Highest alert RED on 2021-07-02 only. Highlight up to 8 actions suitable for RED. Choose varied: ENERGY_DISCOM_HOSPITAL_SUPPLY_CARE, ENERGY_POWER_PRIORITY_CRITICAL_FACILITIES, COMMS_ALERT_TO_HOSPITALS_PRACTITIONERS, HEALTH_108_SMS_VULNERABLE_AREAS, MUNI_COOLING_CENTRES_ACTIVATE, MUNI_DRINKING_WATER_DISTRIBUTION, WORK_SHIFT_AWAY_1_5PM, PUBLIC_CHECK_VULNERABLE_NEIGHBOURS. That's 8.

Day sentences: each one short, include colour name only that day's colour. So day1 RED, others GREEN. Must not mention other colours. So day2 sentence cannot mention RED, only GREEN. Provide forecast max maybe. Use numbers given. Eg "Friday 2 July: maximum around 41 °C, RED alert." Use rounded whole numbers. 40.6 -> 41. Others: 39.6 -> 40, 39.3 -> 39, 39.1 -> 39, 39.2 -> 39. Include normal? Not required. Just one short sentence about forecast. Include colour.

Summary: 2-3 sentences: highest alert level RED on Friday 2 July, watch vulnerable people and heat health. Mention colours that occur: RED and GREEN. Must only name those colours. So "RED" and "GREEN". Provide 2 sentences.

Now construct JSON.
